source: Best guess at a factory-fresh TB-303: the x0x model with nominal components and the service-manual cutoff trim
reference_set: derived from x0x.json; no recording of a new unit
component_state: new: electrolytics at nominal, TM3 trimmed per the service procedure
notes: x0x.json with the parts that age or drift reset to the schematic: cutoff trim so the service check (Cutoff centre, Resonance max, Env Mod/Decay/Accent min, saw on C) rings at ~500 Hz / 2 ms (x0x unit: 336 Hz); C13 network at nominal (R46 x C13 47 ms, VR4b x C13 50 ms, mix 100 ms); VEG tau R123 x C42 = 1.5 s; MEG tau 68 ms - 1.068 s; accented MEG 68 ms. Pot laws (Env Mod S-curve, Decay taper), the D24 drop, VCA attack and onset delay are kept from the x0x fit: they are circuit or pot characteristics, not ageing. An extrapolation, not a measurement.
